layout.title: How a tunnel under a river is built

shows.does: a shaft is dug beside the river and a dark hole is bored sideways under the riverbed while a boat floats above
mud lumps fall from the roof of the hole and river water pours down and floods its floor
a yellow steel shield appears in the hole and pushes forward, its cutter wheel spinning, the water drains
a glowing outline traces the shield
behind the machine, lumps of soil fall from the bare walls
concrete ring segments line the tunnel walls
water drips through a joint between two rings
dark rubber strips appear in every joint and the drip stops
smoky air builds up inside the closed tunnel
fans appear along the ceiling and spin, the smoke clears and air arrows run through
rain runs down the shaft into the tunnel and pools at its low point
a pump starts and water runs up a pipe toward the river, the pool drains
a road appears along the tunnel floor and lamps light up along the ceiling while the boat sails over
the lit tunnel runs under the river

layout.why: A river with a boat in a riverbed, and the tunnel seen in section under it from a shaft on the bank; the story follows the tunnel as it is driven (the hole, the shield, the rings behind it, the sealed tube, its air and its low point). Each problem is physical (mud falling and water flooding in, walls crumbling, a joint dripping, smoke, a pool at the bottom), and it ends with the road and lights under the river while the boat sails over.

sentences.text: If you dig a hole under a river, you have a tunnel.
But soft mud caves in, and the river floods in.
So a spinning steel shield pushes forward.
This is a tunnel boring machine.
But behind the shield, the bare walls crumble.
So you line the walls with concrete rings.
But water squeezes through the joints between rings.
So rubber seals squeeze each joint shut.
But with the seals tight, smoky air gets trapped.
So big fans swap the smoke for fresh air.
But past the fans, rain pools at the lowest point.
So pumps lift it back up to the river.
Pave the road, light it, and drive under the river.
Congratulations, you have built a tunnel.
